mod.name: Placeable
config.placeable.option.placed_without_t: Allow placement on blocks without a top rim.
If enabled, plants may float and unknown bugs may occur!
config.placeable.option.enable_universal: Allows ANY block to be placed on ANY other block. Warning: This can cause physics issues!
config.placeable.option.require_sneak.to: When enabled, you must sneak to place blocks normally. Without sneaking, blocks will be placeable anywhere.
